description: User-selectable model ids available through OpenAI's Codex CLI via the ChatGPT OAuth path. The CLI fetches its model catalog from chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex, which is separate from the general OpenAI API. Picker metadata comes from codex-rs/models-manager/models.json in the openai/codex repo; visibility "list" models are offered in the picker, while visibility "hide" models may remain available when named explicitly. GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra require Codex 0.166.0 or newer; GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol require Codex 0.153.0 or newer; GPT-6.1 Terra was added on 2026-10-26; GPT-6.1 Sol is in staged rollout. GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna require Codex 0.155.0 or newer. GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark retired on 2026-09-14 and is omitted. GPT-5.5 remains selectable in the picker with upgrade recommendation to GPT-6 Sol. gpt-5.2 was removed from the bundled catalog as retired. The generic API id gpt-5.6 is excluded because current Codex documentation and the bundled catalog do not establish its availability through ChatGPT sign-in. The latest bundled slug/visibility pairs were checked at commit 6c0cee50 (2026-11-17), following 126a0ee9 (2026-10-26). Models requiring separate approval and provisioning, including gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and gpt-daybreak-red-latest, are excluded, as is internal-only codex-auto-review.
